description.narrative: Projektet syftar till uthållig användning och bevarande av växtgenetiska resurser i Öst-Afrika.

Support to ASARECA/EAPGREN, a regional joint project for the National Agricultural Research Systems (NARS) of ASARECA member states. EAPGREN Phase II has also included Somalia and Djibouti unlike Phase I. The project purpose is to promote sustainable use and conservation of plant genetic resources in Eastern Africa.

During the earlier support, ASARECA successfully enhanced human capacity development in plant genetic resources (PGR), germplasm acquisition and basic infrastructural development for PGR conservation. EAPGREN Phase II was designed to address the challenges in the 1st phase and focuses more on sustainable utilization of PGR through effective characterization and evaluation of germplasm and capacity building through infrastructural development, conservation facilities and training. No significant results are expected from the present intervention, which only concerns the bridging phase 2013 -2017.The contribution had to be suspended in 2014 after only one year of implementation due to suspicions of corruption following a whistle blower's announcement and forensic audit. The agreement was formally ended in 3 March 2016. There has been no engagement whatsoever between Sweden and ASARECA on the implementation of the program. The only focus has been on the forensic issues. The cooperation is best described as cordial. The amount to be repaid was the result of a negotiated procedure. ASARECA has diplomatic immunity and a legal process against the organization was not considered a viable option. After a dialogue a total sum of USD 477 763 was agreed by both parties. It should be noted that the decision on repayment mentions a sum of 4,156,460 SEK, which amounted to USD 477 763 according to OANDA exchange rates on the day of signing the decision. ASARECA repaid USD 477 763 to sida on 2017-07-26, however, with the exchange rate on the day of repayment, the final amount received in SEK was 3 905 402.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
